highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and SkSL RasterPipeline code generation.
highlights_body: This servicing release prevents stale GPU readbacks, restores resolve and mipmap state after failed work, and corrects framebuffer deletion on Imagination GPUs. It also fixes a child-effect map-pointer lifetime issue in SkSL RasterPipeline code generation.

bullets.lead: Ganesh handles failed GPU work consistently
bullets.detail: Readbacks propagate failed flushes, resolve and mipmap dirty tracking is restored after dropped work, internal flush results are checked, and Imagination framebuffer deletion is corrected.
Child-effect map entries are dereferenced before map growth can invalidate their pointers during code generation.

v4.150.2.summary: Improves Ganesh behavior when GPU work fails. Readbacks no longer return stale texture data after a failed flush, resolve and mipmap dirty tracking is restored after dropped work, internal flush results are checked, and framebuffer deletion is corrected on Imagination GPUs. Also fixes a child-effect map-pointer lifetime issue in SkSL RasterPipeline code generation.

harfbuzz_summary: Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2 as a package revision following 14.2.1.1.
